capabilities: Record voice notes and transcribe them via STT into raw/
Compile raw notes into wiki summaries, concepts and entities pages with an LLM
Link generated pages together with wikilinks and refresh index and log files
Watch raw/ for new or changed files and auto-compile them
Queue raw files for approval before compilation
extras: Not yet published to the community plugin directory ('Once published, install EchoWiki'); README includes maintainer release steps and an optional Node.js CLI for headless compilation; API keys are stored locally in the plugin's data.json.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically turn unprocessed notes and voice recordings into organized, wikilinked wiki pages.

relations.evidence: bundling the compiler and Vercel AI SDK in-process

requires.name: STT API key for voice transcription

summary: Local-first LLM agent that compiles raw notes and voice transcripts into a structured, interlinked wiki of summaries, concepts and entities.
